_readme: The style bank for AI video production: every STYLE the video machine can render a piece in, one row each. A style answers ONE question — what does it look like? It never changes what the film says, who carries it, or its beats; any format can be made in any style. A row is a STYLE LOCK: `formula` is the one canonical string the variation chain (format-variation.md, machine/restyle.py) prepends byte-identical to every asset and clip; `motion` is the movement language, a separate axis. `seen_as` is what the internet calls it, kept only so a swipe can be matched to a row — never used as a name. `ip_flag` is printed on any row whose common name is someone's trademark; the rule is the generic look, never their characters or logos. Swatches are the SAME approved frame restyled through the image door, so the only thing that differs between two swatches is the style. Only Damon signs a row approved. `keeps_proof` is read off the swatch by eye: does the skin problem in the original frame survive the restyle (yes / faint / no). A 'no' style can carry a hook, a story or a mechanism scene, never a before-and-after.
the_test: If you can swap it and the script, the cast and the beats all stay the same — it is a style. If the script or who carries it has to change — it is a format.

families.handmade: built by hand on a tabletop
families.photoreal: looks filmed — the grade, the lens and the era do the work

styles.name: Claymation
styles.what: Everything is hand-sculpted modelling clay, shot frame by frame on a tabletop set.
styles.formula: stop-motion claymation: every surface hand-sculpted plasticine with visible thumbprints and tool marks, slightly lumpy proportions, matte clay skin, tiny handmade props, soft tabletop studio light, shallow depth of field of a miniature set
styles.motion: animated on twos, tiny jitter between frames, no motion blur
styles.source: named by Damon 2026-09-20 (agency Notion page + Instagram '21 ad formats' list)

styles.name: Paper cut-out
styles.what: Layered cut paper and card, flat shapes with real paper shadows between the layers.
styles.formula: layered paper-craft: every shape cut from coloured card and construction paper, visible fibre texture and cut edges, stacked layers casting small real drop shadows, flat colour, no gradients, lit like a shadow box
styles.motion: pieces slide, hinge and pop like puppets on pins; stepped timing
styles.source: named by Damon 2026-09-20 (agency Notion page + Instagram '21 ad formats' list)

styles.name: Crochet
styles.what: Everything is knitted or crocheted yarn — soft amigurumi people and props.
styles.formula: crochet amigurumi: every person and object made of chunky yarn stitches, visible loops and fuzz, safety-eye faces, stuffed rounded forms, felt details, warm soft window light, macro lens look
styles.motion: gentle wobble, stop-motion on twos, yarn squashes softly
styles.source: named by Damon 2026-09-20 (agency Notion page + Instagram '21 ad formats' list)

styles.name: Needle felt
styles.what: Matted wool felt figures, fuzzier and more sculpted than crochet.
styles.formula: needle-felted wool: figures and props sculpted from matted wool roving, fuzzy halo of stray fibres on every edge, bead eyes, muted natural dyes, miniature handmade set, soft daylight
styles.motion: stop-motion on twos, fibres shimmer slightly frame to frame
styles.source: named by Damon 2026-09-20 (agency Notion page + Instagram '21 ad formats' list)

styles.name: Felt puppet
styles.what: Hand-and-rod foam puppets with felt skin, big mouths and ping-pong eyes on a TV-studio set.
styles.formula: children's television puppet show: soft fleece-and-foam puppet characters with wide hinged mouths and round plastic eyes, visible fleece texture and stitched seams, bright 1980s television studio lighting, colourful simple set
styles.motion: puppeteered bobbing, mouth flaps on syllables, arms move on rods
styles.ip_flag: Named after a trademarked puppet franchise — keep the look generic, never the characters.
styles.source: named by Damon 2026-09-20 (agency Notion page + Instagram '21 ad formats' list)

styles.name: Brick figure
styles.what: A world of snap-together plastic bricks with little cylinder-headed figures.
styles.formula: plastic brick toy world: every object built from glossy interlocking studded bricks, people as small cylinder-headed toy figures with printed faces and claw hands, injection-moulded plastic sheen, macro photography of a toy set, shallow depth of field
styles.motion: stiff stop-motion, figures hop and swivel at the waist, on twos
styles.ip_flag: Trademarked toy system — never show the logo or licensed figures.
styles.source: named by Damon 2026-09-20 (agency Notion page + Instagram '21 ad formats' list)

styles.name: Miniature diorama

styles.formula: handmade miniature diorama: scale-model buildings, painted figurines, static grass and model trees, tilt-shift lens with a thin band of focus, bright hobby-lamp light, slight plastic sheen
styles.motion: slow overhead drift, figures move in tiny stop-motion steps
styles.source: named by Damon 2026-09-20 (agency Notion page + Instagram '21 ad formats' list)

styles.name: Anime
styles.what: Japanese TV animation — clean ink lines, flat cel shading, big expressive eyes, painted backgrounds.
styles.formula: Japanese anime: clean black line art, two-tone cel shading, large expressive eyes, glossy hair highlights, detailed hand-painted background, soft bloom on light sources
styles.motion: held poses with snappy moves, speed lines, hair and cloth sway, animated on threes

styles.name: 1950s hand-drawn cel

styles.ip_flag: Keep it period-generic; never a studio's characters.

styles.motion: full fluid character animation, anticipation and follow-through, slow push-ins

styles.name: 3D cutaway explainer
styles.what: Glossy 3D simulation that flies inside a body or object to show what is happening.
styles.formula: 3D science-explainer animation render: smooth simplified mannequin-like figure with matte neutral-grey surface, clean dark studio void background, soft even light, one glowing highlighted region with a floating magnified inset showing a simple stylised diagram of skin layers, saturated colour only on the part being explained
styles.motion: continuous camera fly-in from outside to inside, parts animate mechanically, labels pop on
styles.ip_flag: Named after a creator — the look is generic 3D explainer.
styles.source: named by Damon 2026-09-20 (agency Notion page + Instagram '21 ad formats' list)
styles.proof_note: It did more than keep the spots — it lit them up and added a magnified skin inset. The natural home for a mechanism scene.

styles.name: Skeleton character
styles.what: A friendly glossy 3D skeleton living a normal life — the narrator of body stories.
styles.formula: stylised 3D skeleton character: clean ivory bones with soft gloss, big round eye sockets with expressive pupils, wearing everyday clothes, everyday real-world setting, soft cinematic light, shallow depth of field
styles.motion: full character animation, exaggerated jaw on speech, bones clack subtly
styles.source: named by Damon 2026-09-20 (agency Notion page + Instagram '21 ad formats' list)
styles.proof_note: No skin, so no skin proof. It carries the story and the hook; the proof scene has to cut to a real-skin style.

styles.name: Phone-camera UGC

styles.motion: handheld micro-shake, natural pauses, no cuts inside a line
